title: Show release versions and getting-started steps in the EAP cockpit
summary: The Early Access Preview cockpit now displays release versions in the list and opens a dedicated details page with getting-started steps, overview content, and action links for each feature.
key_points: New dedicated details page shows full feature overview with numbered getting-started guidance
Release version information visible in the compact list view
Help, video, and feature-feedback action links available from the details page
Uses EAP-local metadata instead of cramped FactBox or description field
AL tests added for ordered full text, optional metadata, and malformed values
